label: Bible Study
prompt: Every good _____ and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
verse: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
note: Every good gift traces upstream to the Father of lights.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have _____ the world.
verse: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
note: Jesus says 'I have overcome' the night before the cross — past tense, on purpose.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But Daniel _____ in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king's meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
verse: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king's meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
note: Daniel 'purposed in his heart' before the menu ever arrived — the decision preceded the test.

label: Deep Water
prompt: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my _____ come.
verse: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.
note: Job asks the oldest question about death — and five chapters later answers it with 'I know that my redeemer liveth.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The _____ fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
verse: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
note: 'Effectual fervent prayer' — one Greek word, two KJV adjectives, and much availing.
